name: AppleUpgrades
summary: Upgrades that really work: players earn the currency by pressing (any animated object's clicks and keys) and over time, and buy upgrades that raise what a press or a second pays, or multiply it. The server checks every purchase; levels are saved with the money.

needs.config: ReplicatedStorage.AppleUpgradesConfig: { currency, screen, counter, button, panel, perPress, upgrades = { { id, label, kind = perPress|perSecond|multiplier, amount, cost, growth, max } } }
needs.screen: a studded screen (build_studded_ui) with the counter, the button and the panel whose cards are named by upgrade id

gives.levels: player attribute Upgrade_<id> (saved with the money)
gives.earning: ServerStorage.AppleAnimatePressed pays perPress for every press; perSecond pays every second
